text.text_excerpt: one of the best Pizza Hut's in the city IMO. Always prompt service, and top quality food. Would definitely recommend, it can be a little tricky to find though due to it being ducked off in a shopping center, but i would go back every time!

Look I got throw these guys a bone based on my experience, I know it's a national chain location. First I am in general a support local everything, but that doesn't mean 100% of the time. I've shopped at this Pizza Hut a handful of times over the last three years for carry out, the customer service has been really solid, perhaps some of the negative reviews have been taken to heart and they are consciously taking steps to improve the customer's overall attitude. On a recent visit I ordered carry out at the store and waited in the car for the food to cook, when the order was ready a staff member brought it out to the car for me. This location had a rocky start. The first few times I came here, the pizza was horrible and seriously made me question my love of Pizza Hut. But, with time they definitely found their groove and pulled their act together. I love the new fancy pizzas, especially the garden lover with the balsamic drizzle on thin crust. I also enjoy their BBQ pizzas. I tried the brownie tonight and it was good. Nothing super special except that it was still warm, even after eating my pizza, which was very nice. The interior is a little disorganized and I feel like the employees would probably benefit from adult supervision, but overall they are doing a great job and the staff is friendly.
